avis.titre: ★★★★★ Wake Up With Actually Soft Lips – Not Just Shiny Ones
avis.texte: I’ve tried a LOT of lip balms and “overnight” treatments, and most of them either sit on top of your lips or disappear halfway through the night. This one actually works. The texture is thick but not sticky — more like a cushiony balm that melts into your lips after a few minutes. I apply a generous layer before bed, and by morning my lips feel genuinely softer, smoother, and hydrated — not just coated. It’s made a noticeable difference in dryness and fine lines, especially during colder weather. What really impressed me: • It stays put overnight (even with a fan running). • No weird taste or overpowering fragrance. • A tiny amount goes a long way, so the jar will last. • Works great as a daytime gloss in a thin layer too. After about a week of consistent use, I didn’t need to constantly reapply lip balm during the day anymore. That alone makes this a win. If you deal with dry, flaky, or cracked lips — especially in winter or dry climates — this is absolutely worth trying. Five stars from me. I’ll definitely repurchase.

avis.titre: Actually hydrates — not just glossy. I have new lips.Actually hydrates — not just glossy. I have new lips.
avis.texte: OK!! Back again with my obsession with Medicube. I have no affiliation with them. They don’t pay me lol. I’m only a few days in and I’m already obsessed with this. My lips were so dry before using it, and the difference has been noticeable almost immediately. They feel softer, smoother, and actually hydrated — not just coated. I drink tons of water and am very hydrated, but my lips just always take a beating in the winter and this has changed it in 4 days. The texture is really nice too. It goes on slightly thicker, but if you give it a few seconds it settles in and doesn’t feel overly sticky. I’ve been using it as a lip mask and even during the day because it wears so comfortably. It’s that good. There’s a very subtle berry/bubblegum scent that isn’t overpowering, which I appreciate. I would absolutely repurchase this — it performs better than a lot of higher-end lip products I’ve tried. This one really works.

I've always been skeptical of chopsticks or any lip care because I've heard companies put stuff in them to mess your lips up more, making you buy more chapstick, etc. I love medicube products but my lips have always been horribly chapped and sometimes get an occasional deepppp crack that takes ages to heal because it keeps opening when I smile, etc. I expected this to maybe make my lips less painful, but I woke up and I smiled and the deep crack I went to bed with was GONE. My lips? SO SOFT. Its as if this actually gets into your lip and actually repairs it! I put a generous layer on at night and during the day you can use a tiny bit and it feels like a protective, moisturizing lip balm!

Not my favorite product from medicube (and I have purchased almost all). Don’t take me wrong, it does hydrate but not as I expected. It has fragrance and it’s a bit stickier. If you like fragrance and a thicker sticky consistency, this is your must buy.

avis.titre: Hydrating but doesn't last too long
avis.texte: This is a nice lip mask. It's such a fun color and has a nice flavor to it as well. I love the feeling when it goes on and it gives you a tiny bit of a pink tint. My only complaint is how long it lasts. I'd say it moisturizes my lips for 1-2 hours max. It's wonderful for short term hydration, but I would try a different lip mask if you're looking for something to last you until the morning.

Amazing lip balm! I highly recommend especially for after the winter season and during summer when tanning and out in the sun! This stuff is so buttery soft. Smooth like velvet! No heavy scent. Just amazing! I put it on before bed and wake up to pillow soft lips!
I live in a dry climate. I love this stuff my lips are usually chapped all year. I use this at night but often during the day. It feels so good and hydrates without feeling like lip gloss

avis.titre: Makes my lips moist for the morning
avis.texte: I bought this and really like it. It moisturizes my lips while I sleep and it’s a cute shade of pink. You could almost wear it out on the town.
Verwende ich sehr regelmäßig und ist auch schon halb leer. Ich kann es nur empfehlen.
Horrible fake smell and taste. Really disappointed had to chuck it away.

No sentí que fuera una mascarilla, solo es un bálsamo normal que si lo quieres usar de día debes usar poco porque pinta de rosa blancoso tus labios y de noche da igual. No sentí una gran hidratación entonces por el precio es mejor comprar un bálsamo común
Ive been using medicine for over 2 years now. And first time trying the lip treatment. I love it so much it's super soft. I love their pdrn products

Very smooth silky lip mask. Very faint smell and no taste. It is very hydrating and nice to put on before bed. Beware though the pink will stain whatever it material it gets on I have permanent stain on my sheet from it and I can’t get it out. All in all it’s a great lip mask I even use it throughout the day for hydration on the lips.

avis.titre: Heavily perfume lip mask, but pleasant
avis.texte: I like the feel and texture of this mask, but it has such an overwhelming perfume scent that I do not reach for it. It is moisturizing. It does not taste as bad as it smells. It smells way a lot stronger than any other lip mask I have. If you don’t mind a heavily perfumed lip mask you might enjoy it, I actually like everything else about it. I would give us five stars if it was unscented or even had a pleasant light scent.

It’s good. Definitely meant for nine times as it leaves a pale pink tint that I’m not a fan of and is very moisturizing. Keeps my lips smooth, but constantly has them peeling. Not sure if this is normal. I kinda like it because my lips are always smooth lol.

I love Medicube products in all. This one is no exception! I've used many different lip masks. This one is the only one that I can comfortably say the most effective one without drying out in the morning.
Este producto me encanta porque deja mis labios muy hidratados.
I LOVE Medicube products! They have literally changed my skin..made it brighter and tighter and I even get compliments on how bright I look ✨

Was very excited to try because I really like medicube w. I’m not sure if this was stored with perfume or something at the warehouse and just took on a smell or if medicube intended on it smelling like horrible flowery perfume. Not just a little, a lot, I feel like someone sprayed it in my mouth. Would deal w the smell if the product was good, but it’s no different than any other normal chapstick/lip balm. Don’t waste your money- I promise u will regret it!
My first time trying this lip mask to see to make my lips so smooth and moisturize🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷

avis.titre: Moisturizing lip mask & have nice subtle scent.
avis.texte: I tried it myself and these could be my favorite lip mask going forward because of the pros mentioned below. Further comments are below: Things I like about this product: - Functional product as overnight lip mask - Soft and moist. Kept lips moisturized for longer period of time - Easy to apply - Nice subtle scent Things that need improvement: - Not very reasonably priced for the quantity Overall take: Probably the most moisturizing lip mask that I have tried and so I would recommend these.

avis.titre: medicube PDRN lip sleeping mask glow balm: moisturizing
avis.texte: This is a nice lip balm for overnight. My skin does really well with shea butter and that's one of the key ingredients in this. I find it to be quite hydrating and it feels nice on my lips. I am surprised that I don't see any fragrance or perfume in the ingredients list. I don't like strong fragrances, so I tend to avoid products with those ingredients and I find this to have a stronger fragrance than I would expect without those ingredients. That said, I do like the fruity-floral fragrance/taste of this balm-- it reminds me of flavored lip balms I used as a child/teen.
